nonblocking_findings.details: The source is eligible for the one exact planned deployment, but no R2 bootstrap/stage/final result receipt was supplied as executed evidence. Do not convert four planned stages, 152 planned sequences, 219802 expected noninitialization calls or the 4324 worst-case 50-frame checkpoints into actual launched/completed/sample counts. Actual CUDA state/list/tensor/RNG isolation, W-to-full-prefix record equality, all-event GT labels and full coverage still require completed R2 artifacts. C training, own-policy R4 history, full C comparison and the same-weight final nine metrics remain unexecuted/unproved.

nonblocking_findings.title: Target admission is a timestamped receipt and modeled capacity bound
nonblocking_findings.details: The supplied terminal receipt is exit 0, its embedded JSON exactly equals result, and its canonical remote result is bound into gate. It reports real target filesystem witness sizes within the rounded units at 2026-10-10T05:26:33.885332+00:00, 17449340928 B data-free versus 15730737152 B required (1718603776 B margin), and GPUs 0/1 each 1/24576 MiB at that observation. This supplements the prior BytesIO-only evidence; it does not establish persistent GPU reservation, future free space, actual total R2 bytes, peak VRAM/RAM or measured full-Train runtime. Bootstrap rechecks data-free immediately before Popen, while the GPU snapshot remains the recorded observation. This reviewer did not reconnect, reread raw remote PT files or deserialize them.

nonblocking_findings.title: Assertion and observation claims have explicit source boundaries
nonblocking_findings.details: Controller is launched with PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 and its collect/replay children inherit that environment; all stage argv omit -O/-OO. The bootstrap command itself has no optimization flag but inherits the remote shell environment: its assert __debug__ is itself removed if Python is externally optimized. There is no evidence of an optimizing environment, so this is not treated as an invented source blocker, but actual bootstrap sys.flags.optimize has not been attested. The source declares the first permitted NN observation at launch+1 hour and never busy-polls; subsequent at-most-hourly external observations are an operator/workflow obligation, not enforced by a scheduler in these files. One-shot root/launch guards and single wrapper subprocesses provide no automatic restart; a partial or failed launch must not be reported as completion.

nonblocking_findings.title: Original semantic limits remain unchanged
nonblocking_findings.details: The immutable split is a C-only optimization holdout because A+B saw all 152 sequences; the existing bank exception pine02_wild_320 (five semicolon clauses in one retained slot) is not repaired or newly relabeled. Future/current C consumers and identical feature transforms remain prospective; the audited teacher emits the common exact 519-float32 contract. Saved W versus full native prefix is an asserted comparison of record dictionaries, not proof that native-prefix query/feature tensors were saved or compared. The old primary report remains authoritative for these inherited ceilings.

summary: The exact attempt2 deployment is source-eligible for a single guarded launch; all concrete hash/argv/closure checks pass. Target CPU filesystem admission is supplied and bound. No actual R2 launch, full teacher run, C training or final performance is attested.
blocking_scope: exact supplied source/package and prerequisite receipt consistency; runtime must still pass its own gates
review_mode: supplemental turn of original source reviewer; no fresh independent external reviewer

A_gt_provenance.evidence_scope: unchanged source and immutable inputs; no new R2 labels
A_gt_provenance.details: The actual argv retain the original Train152 spec, trained P1 result, final, human bank and human labels. The called load_truth path reads dataset groundtruth.txt with the per-sequence locked SHA/count/first-box checks. Neither deployment code nor collection adds a GT filter. Replay writes W/K predictions before loading dataset GT. Full Train152 R2 GT outputs have not been produced or audited.

B_no_prediction_derived_or_self_normaliz.details: The future target remains the signed mean of IoU_W minus IoU_K over valid future dataset GT frames; current target is dataset GT IoU. Native response >0.75 and the 50-frame schedule select native events only. They neither become reference labels nor normalize the utility target. All negative/zero/unknown/tail events are retained; common eligibility requires current-valid and at least one future-valid frame.

C_no_phantom_launch_training_or_results.evidence_scope: prepared materials and recorded target CPU admission
C_no_phantom_launch_training_or_results.details: The prepared receipt explicitly records NN_calls=0, NN_progress_queries=0, NN_deployed=false and NN_launched=false. Four stage commands and two physical GPUs are plans. The target admission is CPU serializer/storage work plus one resource query, with CUDA uninitialized, no teacher examples and no R2 launch. Bootstrap can only later attest a controller Popen/proc-cmdline; that receipt explicitly cannot prove completion. R0 and R1 statuses refer to their separately completed historical audits, not an R2 result.

D_called_versus_dead_paths.evidence_scope: literal argv, decoded embedded code and source call graph
D_called_versus_dead_paths.details: Both native wrappers are single subprocess calls with returned exit status. The SSH blob decodes byte-for-byte to the supplied bootstrap; it launches the supplied controller; that controller constructs the same four commands as stage_argv.json; teacher.main calls context then collect/replay. stage_argv.json is a review/display artifact, not a file read by the controller. immutable_C_plan/C_split are hash-bound prospective protocol files; R2 correctly traverses all original Train152 rather than using the C fit/dev split. gate.assertions_enabled is metadata; actual controller assertion enablement comes from the explicit PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 environment.

E_prepared_source_scope.details: All 20 original review inputs remain byte-identical, and the copied teacher/controller/features remain the initially audited versions. The concrete package supplies the previously absent deployment gate/argv and target-filesystem receipt. This closes those preparation prerequisites at source/receipt scope. It supplies no executed R2 record comparison, CUDA reconstruction result, full teacher coverage, C optimizer step, R3/R4 outcome or R5 metrics.

F_proxy_versus_real_GT.details: Native response/selected_quality/observation are current/past features or event-eligibility signals, not dataset truth. W/K utility uses actual dataset boxes after predictions. Capacity C/history zeros are explicitly shape placeholders, not observed features, labels, teacher examples or C training data. The signed 32-frame geometric utility is not an identity label, long-term causal-performance result or proof of final nine-metric success.

launch_failure_and_completion_gates.full_coverage_before_complete: exact indices 0..151, 219802 noninitialization calls, equal fixed inputs across 4 stage outputs, collected and replayed event count equality

observation_schedule.external_observer_enforcement: outside this source; no observer executed

target_admission.classification: previous actual target CPU filesystem serializer witness plus one resource snapshot; reviewed locally without reexecution

result.serializer_scope: real R1 containers with explicit zero C/history shape placeholders for capacity only; not teacher examples

allowed: The unchanged R2 source plus exact attempt2 package passed this source deployment review with zero source blockers.
The target admission receipt reports a successful actual CPU filesystem sizing/admission snapshot with no NN/CUDA execution.
Controller and teacher children have assertions enabled by explicit inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 source configuration.
The controller uses two blocking per-GPU collect-then-replay pipelines and no busy status polling.
forbidden: R2 has launched or all four stages have run.
Full Train152 teacher collection/replay/GT coverage or sample counts are completed.
Saved W and full native-prefix query/features have been compared; only record comparisons are implemented.
C-current/C-future training or the same-input deployment transforms have already been executed.
Target GPU/RAM/VRAM reservation or total actual R2 storage/runtime is measured by this source review.
Capacity placeholder zeros are real C features, labels or examples.
C or P1 meets the final same-weight nine-metric goal.
Requested Astra/max is attested backend identity or this supplement is cross-family acceptance.
